class_reason: All six targets reproduced to the paper's rounding by the unchanged deposited script (T6 with the first pre-registered formula), with no code edits.
confidence_reason: Unchanged code, checksummed deposit files, deterministic estimator; subset and full runs gave identical numbers (pending agreement with agent B per PROTOCOL section 8).

EXPLORATORY (not pre-registered): PREREG inconsistency 1 has no effect on this deposit: rows with complete Model 3 variables = 7163, of which 0 are dropped only by the extra na.omit columns (outputs/exploratory_na_rows.json, plain CSV count).
